newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal says books $543 mln business.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal says books $543 mln business.

text.p: AlliedSignal Aerospace said Monday it booked $543 million in new business at the Paris Air Show.

AlliedSignal said the new business include $50 million in contracts for Sikorsky's new S-92 medium-lift helicopter; $175 million for its F124 turbofan engine that will power Aero Vodochody's L-159 trainer for the Czech Air Force and $88 million in contracts for Airbus aircraft operators worldwide.

The company said it also booked $100 million in business for its joint venturer propulsion engine systems for the Ayres Loadmaster utility aircraft and $130 million in avionics and brake business with a number of German, Russian and Turkish airlines.
"These new contracts reflect the continuing strong growth of our aerospace business and the overall resurgence of the industry." said Dan Burnham, president, AlliedSignal Aerospace.
